title: maclura andamanica
intro: Maclura andamanica, commonly known as the Andaman fig, is a species of fig tree native to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents contribute to the plant's potential in treating various diseases, including cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular disorders.
